verdict.rationale: Proration math for mid-cycle plan changes is a fair question for an invoicing product, but the evidence pack never mentions proration, partial-period calculation, or upgrade/downgrade handling. Credit notes for adjusting finalized invoices, invoice previews, and automatic reconciliation are related features, not documented prorated billing math, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, mid-cycle upgrades and downgrades are prorated with documented, auditable math — credits, partial periods, and invoice line items that reconcile to the penny
